inbox.headline: Oil prices jump as US and Iran trade attacks over Strait of Hormuz
inbox.prelim_note: Commodity/macro + supply-demand: Brent +4.14% to $79.16/bbl and WTI +2.97% to $74.38/bbl after a fourth wave of US strikes on Iran and Iranian missile/drone retaliation against Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan; the Strait of Hormuz (~1/5 of global oil trade) is now near-standstill, with war-risk insurance up to 3-5% of vessel value.

inbox.headline: SK Hynix Shares Plunge Most on Record in Deepening Korea Selloff

inbox.headline: Samsung Brings Forward Yongin AI Chip Fab Launch to 2029
